assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished cinematic key art for the main menu of a portrait mobile space strategy game called Die letzte Werft. Create a vertical 1024x1536 illustration with absolutely no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark. A solitary operational shipyard orbital station is humanity's safe home, suspended over the dark night side of a distant planet. Sophisticated hard-surface science fiction, practical ivory and dark navy modular hulls, restrained brass structural details, two unmistakable drydock arms framing a small carrier under repair, subtle cyan dock lighting and warm amber maintenance lights, a tiny sense of scale from two support craft. Hopeful resilience and quiet tension, not a battle scene, no laser beams, no starfield noise. Premium painted 3D concept-art finish with excellent legible silhouettes. Composition for a portrait game menu: the upper 30 percent is calm deep navy negative space for a title; the detailed shipyard is centered in the middle 45 percent, comfortably contained within the frame; the lower 25 percent fades gently into almost-black navy for menu buttons. Camera is an elegant oblique cinematic view, deliberately different from the top-down battlefield. Restrained navy/ivory/brass/cyan palette, believable materials, soft rim light from the planet, beautiful controlled contrast. No extra buildings, no fleet battle, no decorative HUD rings.
assets.use: Main menu key art; unedited original

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas for a mobile portrait space strategy game, two equal square frames arranged horizontally in a wide 2:1 transparent PNG. Primary request: exactly two states of the same enemy orbital SHIELD RELAY structure, active on the left and disabled on the right. Orthographic top-down camera looking straight down, absolutely no perspective or visible sides, centered identical scale and silhouette in both frames. Compact sophisticated hard-surface station with dark graphite panels, restrained copper metal, four short radial armored arms and a strong circular central shield generator. Active frame: clear bright violet and cyan central core, small violet power coils, controlled restrained illumination. Disabled frame: exact same hull and orientation, core dark and cracked, a few scorched panels, no power lights, recognizably disabled but hull remains as rubble. Each object occupies about 70 percent of its square frame, comfortably spaced, no fragments crossing frames. Premium clean 3D game sprite finish, crisp outer silhouette and readable details at 70px, materials and light consistent in both states. Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the objects; no space background, no floor, no drop shadow beyond hull, no starfield. Constraints: no text, labels, numbers, logos, UI, border, grid, reference lines, watermark, rings around the entire object, extra spacecraft or other objects. Both states must be visible from directly overhead and share the same center within their respective halves.
assets.use: Unedited transparent two-state atlas; runtime draws left active / right disabled

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production game sprite atlas for the portrait mobile space strategy game Die letzte Werft, containing exactly two related modular space stations in a horizontal two-cell grid.
Primary request: create a polished coherent station family matching warm ivory hull plating, aged brass edges, graphite mechanical recesses and small restrained cyan lights. True orthographic top-down view, camera exactly perpendicular to the deck, flat readable silhouettes with sophisticated painted 3D surface detail.
Composition: 2:1 landscape canvas, equal square cells, centers exactly at 25% and 75% of the full canvas width and 50% of its height. Each sprite occupies at most 76% of its own square cell, with completely transparent spacing all around. No sprites touching or crossing the central cell boundary.
LEFT cell: harbor repair and habitation dock, a broad U-shaped industrial facility opening towards the bottom of the image, with two long parallel docking arms and a sturdy upper crosspiece containing a small central cyan reactor. Spacious transparent open bay inside. No spacecraft inside.
RIGHT cell: civilian evacuation jump station, a compact segmented octagonal ring with an open transparent circular aperture in its center, four short sturdy external docking spokes, distinct symmetrical silhouette, small cyan energy conduits around the ring, matching the dock's modular construction materials.
Lighting: soft overhead upper-left illumination, short internal shadows only. Readable at 80 pixels tall. Large clear armor panels, restrained mechanical detail, crisp clean edges. A modest premium strategy-game style, not pixel art.
Constraints: actual RGBA transparency behind and inside the open structures. No starfield, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow outside silhouettes, no ships, no people, no typography, no logos, no watermark, no labels, no UI, no decorative neon halos. Absolutely no perspective, isometric angle, horizon or visible side elevations.
assets.use: Unedited RGBA atlas; left harbor dock, right evacuation station; also used by the campaign harbor-state emblem

assets.prompt: Use case: game-environment atlas. Create a single landscape 3:2 image containing EXACTLY THREE equal-width portrait panels side by side, with no borders, no gaps, no text, no ships, no UI. Each panel is a complete orthographic top-down space battlefield background for a premium mobile strategy game, viewed from directly above, consistent sophisticated hand-painted sci-fi art direction. Crucial composition: central 65% of EACH panel is extremely dark quiet navy empty space for small ships to read, never bright clouds or busy details in the center. LEFT PANEL: abandoned wreck corridor, fragmented charcoal ship hulls along the extreme left and right edges, sparse cool lavender starlight, a broken circular wreck at upper outer edge. MIDDLE PANEL: amber salvage outpost, industrial girders and rust-gold mining fragments hugging only the outer edges, a subtle warm distant planet sliver at upper right edge, center remains deep dark quiet blue. RIGHT PANEL: functioning home shipyard, elegant ivory and dark teal drydock piers hugging left and right edges, small cyan navigation lights, architectural sense of a harbor, open dark central approach. The three panels must read as different places without merely changing color. No playable stations in center, those will be drawn separately. Deep restrained contrast, cinematic but calm, fine material detail at edges only, no neon wash, no perspective, no horizon, no typography or markings.
assets.use: Unedited three-panel environment atlas for opening missions
